architecture: ResNet18 single-channel, ImageNet-pretrained first convolution projected to 1 channel
fold_policy: stratified by the 7 manual labels and augmentation type; the four variants from each base mod-split image are assigned to distinct folds when k_folds >= 4
augmentation_policy: sort trials, build floor(n / target_trials) round-robin mod-split chunks, distribute remainder trials one per round into a separate remainder chunk, fill that remainder chunk to target_trials with deterministic random unique trials from the same origin; positive rows keep all chunks, no_class rows keep one deterministic chunk by default; each kept chunk is rendered as reference, inverse_sort, inverse_polarity, and inverse_sort_inverse_polarity
task: binary ERP pattern class vs no_class
preprocessing: variant sort direction and polarity on raw fixed-trial chunk -> zscore_timepoints -> Gaussian smoothing -> resize to 64x64
